title: British Columbia, 1849-1900
description: Examines the foundations of modern British Columbia from the founding of the colony of Vancouver Island including indigenous-settler relations, gold rushes, settlement patterns, Indian policy, treaties, residential schools, Asian immigration, race relations, environment, economy and the origins of BC's peculiar politics
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HSTR 324B, HIST 354B.
recommendations: HSTR 230A and HSTR 230B, or HSTR 324A recommended prior to HSTR 324B.
